pipeline.method: Dense output-space mesh rendered orthographically from +Y (2 mm cells, highest upward-facing surface wins; colour + metallic-roughness from the dense textures); repainted onto low-poly texels of faces with normal.y > minNy and centroid above yMin; their normal texels set flat. Fixes closest-surface bake hits on the dark interior below a coarse simplified cap.

Dense output-space mesh rendered in cylindrical (theta, y) space about the vertical axis through the bbox centre (0.5 deg x 2 mm cells, outermost outward-facing surface wins; colour + metallic-roughness from the dense textures); repainted onto low-poly texels of outward side faces in the band; normal texels set flat.

Coverage of all low-poly faces rasterised per texture (texel centres inside); lib/bake.mjs dilate() re-run from covered texels into uncovered gutter texels (8 iterations) so gutters follow the repainted colours.
